v-clear.mp3: Today we are looking at prepositions of place. I am sitting next to the box. In front of the box. And I am behind the box. Now I am under the box. The box is above my head. Now I am dancing between the chair and the box.
v-inat.mp3: We use IN for spaces which are larger and more general, and we use AT for places with more specific activities. If you go to a supermarket, you are probably buying food. If you go to an airport, you are probably catching a flight.
